initialFindingsAndCorrections.finding: Four LV terminals are visibly taller with flat contact plates; three HV terminals shorter. Original mesh reverses this hierarchy.
Both three-terminal rows have matching visible heights; original mesh imposes unequal heights.
Fill tube belongs opposite the visible drive case, not the same end; preserve four LV contact plates independently from three HV bushings.

Mounting/terminal-box long wall is smooth. Opposite long wall and short ends are finned. Original shared fin generator puts cooling behind bracket/box while omitting required short-end fins for pole form.

Right end has three HV contacts; left plan shows two plated contacts, not assumed three. Requires direct source count resolution. Shared panel-leaf orientation also requires power primitive correction.
Four plated LV contacts form staggered two-pair layout on opposite-end flange; original puts four porcelain terminals in straight line and reverses terminal-height hierarchy.
Long walls have visible vertical cooling ribs; original flat tank omits them. Three-row version needs all nine contacts in icon; single-row source supports six contacts.
Two small LV terminals exit upper sidewall perpendicular to wall carrying two horizontal HV bushings; original places LV on roof.
Plan supports two large HV bushings and four small LV contacts, not original one/two. Preserve round tank and two external mounting brackets, without invented pole.
Source has three diagonal front links: left-top to right-bottom, left-bottom to middle-top, middle-bottom to right-top. Original two-link inverted-V is incorrect.
Keep cutaway versus closed front distinction. Source side has high terminal panel and lower mesh vent, absent or incomplete in original.
Nine front HV tabs and six rear LV tabs are visible; original three top tabs erase source busbar layout.
Upper-right front detail is schematic cutaway; source side elevation has vents and no projecting terminal box. Original adds unsupported external box.
Three tall/four short roof contacts supported; side upper/lower vents missing from original. Preserve opaque enclosure and do not borrow mesh/cutaway execution.
Three front and four rear upper terminal plates plus three front coil plates source-visible; original omits rear row.
Three HV triangular plan and six small secondaries supported. Polygon is mounting-hole diagram, not evidence that there is a hexagonal plate under the cylindrical tank; omit invented plate.
Source plan shows triangular three HV and seven small LV contacts, not original straight-three plus four.

Add source-obvious terminal above upper cylindrical chamber. Five planar small symbols cannot all be reliably classified as secondary bushings versus plugs; do not guess. Geometry withheld pending exact secondary-layout evidence; icon can represent primary exterior silhouette with limitation.
Plan has three small LV contacts, not two.
Conservator runs along long front side with axis parallel tank long axis, not transverse at short end. Outer HV columns splay outward as well as tilt forward.
Outer HV columns splay outward as well as tilt forward; original three parallel tilts erase visible arrangement.
Plan shows seven plated LV contacts, not four; retain three upright taller HV columns.
